programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Maccabi" - "Hapoel"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

Bad Teacher
programme.desc: With the intention of getting a breast implant, Elizabeth becomes a high school substitute teacher. However, when she learns about a bountiful bonus, she strives to get her students the highest marks.

programme.title: New Year's Eve
programme.desc: As the New Year approaches, the eve results in a distinct variety of couples and single people's journeys and stories intertwining.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: A spirited rivalry grows when Peter pushes boundaries with Thomas McGregor, creating chaos around Bea as she offers calm reassurance amid playful tension and shifting intentions.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Realising that Sam has still not come to terms with his wife Maggie's death, his eight-year-old son Jonah forces him to call a national radio talk show, with the hopes of finding him a companion.

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: A successful plastic surgeon attempts to win over a young match teacher by convincing his secretary to pose as his soon-to-be ex-wife.

programme.title: What's Love Got to Do with It?
programme.desc: Filmmaker Zoe Stevenson documents her Pakistani best friend's journey to an arranged marriage. Over time, the process begins to make her challenge her own attitudes towards relationships.

programme.title: Crazy Rich Asians
programme.desc: A professor's world turns upside down when she discovers that her longtime boyfriend belongs to an eccentric, super rich family of business moguls.

programme.title: Just Like Heaven
programme.desc: When grieving architect David moves into a new apartment, he finds the spirit of the last tenant, workaholic doctor Elizabeth, still very much in-residence.

programme.title: Eat Pray Love
programme.desc: Elizabeth Gilbert's perfect world comes shattering down when she gets divorced. She then embarks on a journey across the world in an attempt to rediscover her true self.

programme.title: StreetDance 2
programme.desc: After an embarrassing defeat, a street dancer, Ash, assembles the best dancers from all across the world for another round against the Invincible crew.

programme.title: St. Vincent
programme.desc: Maggie, a working single mother, allows Vincent, a hedonistic misanthrope, to babysit her 12-year-old son Oliver. Soon, a beautiful friendship develops between Vincent and Oliver.

programme.title: Mallika Sherawat; The Love Laugh Live Show
programme.desc: The host invites prominent personalities and engages them in candid conversations about their personal and professional lives.

programme.title: Yashraj Mukhate; The Love Laugh Live Show
programme.desc: The host invites prominent personalities and engages them in candid conversations about their personal and professional lives.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: Ace Ventura, a private detective, specialises in finding lost animals. One day, he is tasked with finding the missing mascot of an American football team.

programme.title: My Best Friend's Wedding
programme.desc: When an old confidante of a woman reveals his engagement, she sets off on a journey to sabotage his wedding after realising her love for him.

programme.title: She's Out of My League
programme.desc: An insecure airport security officer’s world shifts when a confident and beautiful woman shows interest in him, forcing him to confront self-doubt and social expectations.

programme.title: The Emoji Movie
programme.desc: Gene is a smartphone emoji who can show a wide range of emotions instead of just one. When he makes a mistake that threatens his life, he sets out to become normal like his fellow emojis.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: When Django, a slave, is freed, he joins forces with a bounty hunter to rescue his wife, who has been enslaved by Calvin, a hard-hearted plantation owner.

programme.title: Silver Linings Playbook
programme.desc: After spending eight months in a mental institution, a man tries to start a new life.

programme.title: Erin Brockovich
programme.desc: Erin Brockovich lands a job as a legal assistant at Ed Masry's law firm. Here, she builds a case against a power company after she learns that they have been polluting a town's water supply.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
programme.desc: A pregnant assassin, code-named The Bride, goes into a coma for four years after her ex-boss Bill brutally attacks her. When she wakes up, she sets out to get revenge against him and his associates.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: After waking up with amnesia in a hospital, Robert Langdon teams up with Sienna Brooks, one of his doctors, to protect the world from the evil plan of a scientist.

programme.title: Poseidon
programme.desc: On New Year's Eve, the luxury ocean liner Poseidon capsizes after being swamped by a rogue wave. Later, the survivors are left to fight for their lives as they attempt to escape the sinking ship.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A dying curator of the Louvre hides cryptic clues on Da Vinci paintings. Now it is up to Robert Langdon and Sophie Neveu to follow the clues and unearth a secret kept hidden for centuries.

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: After witnessing the horrifying murder of his father, a young man sets out to seek retribution and attempts to bring down a crime lord.

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: Howard Hughes, a germaphobic inventor with mental illness, creates a new plane. Despite personal struggles, he also becomes a successful filmmaker, balancing aviation and Hollywood pursuits.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Tired of Chris's professional failures, his wife decides to separate, leaving him financially broke with an unpaid internship in a brokerage firm and his son's custody to deal with.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Wealthy speedboat racer Ben Aronoff leads a secret life that lands him in trouble with both law enforcement and drug lords.

programme.title: Fallen
programme.desc: Detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of a demonic serial killer, Edgar Reese. However, questions arise when the murders start again, eerily matching the modus operandi of Reese.

programme.title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
programme.desc: Charlie, a 15-year-old introvert, enters high school and is nervous about his new life. When he befriends his seniors, he learns to cope with his friend's suicide and his tumultuous past.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: A few shrewd but oddball fund managers and traders bet against the US mortgage system's stability.
